what: (re-filed from blaze-v2-qu queue 01249, which collided with main's ids) docs/v2/plan/lanes/db/query-unify.md lines 88-89 (backdating) say an lru function value is hashed when it is made. The engine now hashes it when it is evicted, and hashes a rerun value only for a row that was evicted (db/function.rs evict and finish, test an_evictable_function_hashes_its_value_only_when_evicted). Please reword those lines; they are outside The contract, so I left them. Also: a `no_eq` function never hashes, at eviction or rerun, and is never backdated by a hash (every no_eq run is a change; test an_evictable_no_eq_function_never_hashes_and_every_rerun_changes).
